scope: Completed BC and Swedish geological comparisons and selected source-access decisions. Curated research review; no independently learned research policy.

outcome.target: log1p quantified-positive stream-sediment Cu (mg/kg), AAS method

coverage.meaning: Source rows and retained evaluation samples; not new deposits or global coverage.

cost.meaning: Payload size of one archived assay workbook. Transfer retries, metadata, labor and total compute cost were not metered; unknown is not zero.

outcome.decisionUtility: Recorded promotion decision only. Financial value and research-policy utility have not been evaluated.
outcome.nextAction: Retain the spatial baseline. A further geological hypothesis needs a new independent source and frozen evaluation; do not retune on this audit.

sourceDecisions.name: BC RGS2020 assay release
sourceDecisions.outcome: The frozen comparison did not establish reliable improvement. Audit is consumed.
sourceDecisions.revisitWhen: A distinct independent cohort and a preregistered protocol are ready; this release cannot reopen the audit.

sourceDecisions.name: EPA Gunnison permit records
sourceDecisions.permittedUse: Source link and observed access status only; permit facts remain unpublished
sourceDecisions.outcome: The queued URL returned HTTP 404 on one local access check. No original PDF was acquired; document and reuse review remain incomplete. Cached search text is not admitted evidence.
sourceDecisions.revisitWhen: An accessible official copy or a verified official replacement is identified. Do not periodically retry the unchanged URL; do not infer permit revocation from an access failure.

sourceDecisions.name: Cochilco Chile production, covered sales and export destinations
sourceDecisions.permittedUse: Attributed statistics from tables 2.1, 2.3, 2.4, 2.9 and the table 4.9 volume rows only
sourceDecisions.outcome: 250 annual production, 10 covered cathode-sales and 50 export product-weight observations for 2016–2025. Customs destination is not final demand; product weight is not contained copper. Facility routing and available supply remain unknown.
sourceDecisions.revisitWhen: A new release or a decision-relevant table with reviewed original-provider permissions is identified; do not redownload unchanged evidence.

sourceDecisions.name: SGU Swedish atlas copper evaluation
sourceDecisions.permittedUse: CC0 sources; reviewed aggregate evaluation only
sourceDecisions.outcome: The fixed geological candidate failed validation, audit gain and uncertainty gates. Retain the spatial baseline; the audit is consumed.
sourceDecisions.revisitWhen: A new independent cohort and prospectively fixed hypothesis justify another experiment. Never reopen this consumed source, change its seed or repeatedly poll the static release.

sourceDecisions.permittedUse: Source link and Baryon availability review only; no source facts or quantities admitted
sourceDecisions.name: Queensland mineral production workbook availability
sourceDecisions.outcome: One workbook request encountered an HTTP 202 challenge with no workbook received. Table scope, facility identity, mass basis and workbook-specific permissions remain unreviewed. This source has no established Gunnison processing link.
sourceDecisions.revisitWhen: An official replacement, documented availability change or provenance-verified original is available. Do not repeat the challenged request or bypass the challenge; catalogue licensing alone does not complete workbook review.

sourceDecisions.permittedUse: Source link and Baryon availability review only; no source facts or quantities admitted
sourceDecisions.name: USGS copper Yearbook availability
sourceDecisions.outcome: The reviewed copper Yearbook catalogue section linked no chapter later than 2022. A later summary or monthly publication is a different series. No later Magna output observation was acquired; this bounded catalogue screen is not proof that no other source exists.
sourceDecisions.revisitWhen: A publisher announcement or official link identifies a later Copper Yearbook chapter. Do not poll the unchanged catalogue or guess future file URLs. Magna evidence cannot resolve Gunnison identity or available supply.

sourceDecisions.permittedUse: Source link and Baryon availability review only; no source facts or quantities admitted
sourceDecisions.name: AZDEQ Gunnison physical-facility identity screen
sourceDecisions.outcome: A bounded Johnson Camp search in the Records Center and Air Permit Compliance databases returned partial metadata without a linked final original establishing the dated Gunnison electrowinning relationship. The air result was capped. No physical-facility link, final authorization, output or reuse permission was established.
sourceDecisions.revisitWhen: A freely accessible official final original with provenance and reviewed field reuse becomes available, or such an original is supplied. Do not repeat this portal search. Records requests, fees and external communications are outside this workflow.

nextInvestigations.question: What current cathode output can a specified facility sustain?
nextInvestigations.reason: The supply screen has historical context but no current production or uncommitted allocation.
requires: Identify the exact project, facility and process; do not transfer output between related assets.
Review permission, dates, units and evidence of sustained output, quality, inventory and commitments.
Separate a design, permit, announced plan and actual operating measurement.
Honor the recorded EPA, AZDEQ, Queensland and USGS availability stops; repeat acquisition only when the stated trigger changes. An unsuccessful source screen does not satisfy an evidence gate.

nextInvestigations.question: Can a geological hypothesis pass a new independent evaluation?
nextInvestigations.reason: The BC and SGU geological candidates did not pass their fixed gates. Soil, BC and SGU audits are permanently consumed; cross-source scores are not an improvement trend.
requires: Choose an independent, previously unexposed cohort and review lineage/overlap.
Freeze source eligibility, target, baseline, candidate, geological constraints and uncertainty gate before audit exposure.
Keep failed gates; do not rename cohorts, resplit, change seeds or reuse any consumed audit.

nextInvestigations.question: Which permitted source can connect dated output across a copper processing chain?
nextInvestigations.reason: National totals and common ownership do not establish facility-level flow allocations.
requires: Review the selected table and original-provider permissions.
Bind persistent facility IDs, material basis, measurement period and observed output.
Require explicit routing/allocation evidence; leave unknown links and recoveries null.

scheduling.rule: Revisit only on the stated evidence or permission trigger. No recurring download job is installed.

limitations: This review was written after the BC result; it is not preregistration of that experiment or of the next proposals.
Source eligibility and reuse decisions do not certify current operating truth.
Publication of this review changes no audit, membership, evaluator, seed, prediction or model.
Priority is a curated order proposed during implementation; expected utility, costs and improvements in research selection remain unmeasured.
The EPA access observation is a local record of one response, not proof of permanent removal, permit validity or source truth. No permit facts or current output were imported.

SGU review follows its single frozen evaluation. Current-map geochemical independence and QC-parent lineage remain unresolved; no ore, depth, reserves or supply inference. The three experiments have different targets and baselines, so their gains cannot be ranked as a learning trend.

The three October 25 source screens record bounded availability checks, not source observations, complete source coverage, permission grants or measured research-policy gains. No portal record bodies or corporate quantities are exported.

additionalOutcomes.scope: Conditional Swedish till reported-signal prediction given the current map; QC-parent and historical geochemical independence unresolved. No ore, depth, resources, reserves or supply inference.
additionalOutcomes.verificationScope: Pinned source bytes, metadata/context reproduction, fixed membership and trusted local registry orchestration; not independent geological truth or external blinding.
additionalOutcomes.decisionUtility: Rejected this fixed geological correction for the stated cohort. No financial value or learned research-policy gain is measured.
additionalOutcomes.nextAction: Retain the spatial baseline. Preserve the consumed source and fixed split; do not retune or rerun this audit. Prioritize the existing copper workflow and its dated operating evidence gaps.
